g.text: 3D lifting wing: independent comparison with PANAIR A502
NACA 0012 | aspect ratio 6 | semi-span 600 mm | chord 200 mm | angle of attack 4 degrees
Mesh = chord x span. Cp panels: negative (suction) is upward. Lines join the sampled positions only.
Same surface nodes in both solvers. PANAIR has documented corner/abutment warnings.
The deepest tip/wake corner remains unvalidated; an integrated-load check does not certify its peak.
